Beats the B1 anchor 12.9556 by 2.8704 skill units with the whole 3-seed interval [9.7249, 10.3528] below it (5.65 x the certified panel seed_mce 0.5083), and beats the training-free launch best-floor anchor 34.4198 by 24.3345. caveats: THE CARD THAT SET THIS ANCHOR IS FALSIFIED ON ITS OWN PRE-REGISTRATION. r3s2_field_reach-B2's expected_falsification is a disjunction over G1/G2/G3; G2 leg (iii) fires (tools/lsi_transfer_stability_audit.py reports band-mean |T| = 1.1851/1.1851/1.1494 > 1 on the scored cell ifc_poisson at seeds 0/1/2), so the pre-registered instrument repair is NOT accepted. The nRMSE numbers are unaffected - the leg is about the transfer function's stability, not the score - but no claim may be built on this anchor without carrying the failure.

THE IMPROVEMENT OVER THE B1 ANCHOR IS ONE CELL ON ONE SEED. The paired same-job comparand A5_stack_ic_unreg (the literal B1 replay, ridge 0, no band-limit) gives 12.9425, reproducing the B1 anchor to 0.0131. The paired repair effect A5 - A1 is 0.3773 / 0.4620 / 7.7325 skill units on seeds 0 / 1 / 2: BELOW the panel seed_mce 0.5083 on seeds 0 and 1, and carried entirely by seed 2's ifc_poisson blow-up removal (56.12 skill units on that one cell).

The ridge half of the repair never engaged: LOOCV selected ridge = 0 in 13 of 15 (cell x seed) legs (the exceptions are cahn_hilliard seeds 0 and 2 at 1e-6). The whole measured effect is the band-limit, and band 4 of the regularised arm is identically 0 BY CONSTRUCTION on every cell (ring-inclusive k_cut on 2x ladders), which is exactly the band B1 failed in.

ifc_poisson and ifc_heat both LOSE their mandatory affine_on_hf_train floors (3.1298 vs 1.5938 and 1.5755 vs 0.9584) on the 3-seed mean, and ifc_heat also loses nn_condition (1.3941); the panel win is carried entirely by ac/fk/ch. Under the card's own floor-arm rule neither ifc cell yields a claimable route delta.

The scored arm does not beat the training-free stage ladder on ac/fk/ch: A7_emul_only_ic (the front end alone, 100 epochs) is within 0.11 skill units of A1 on all three sharp cells, so the stack's sharp-cell performance IS its front end and the frozen corrector adds nothing there.

Standing panel caveats apply: fisher_kpp weak fidelity gap, allen_cahn trimmed test n=78, cahn_hilliard outlier domination and ratio-of-normals caveat, ifc_poisson exactly-affine condition->HF map, pfc report-only (ADR r3-0004), no cross-round comparison without the honest-denominator flag.
Round-3 success criterion 1 additionally requires exceeding the condition->level closed-form law by >= 1 certified mce on >= 2 scored datasets; this anchor does not adjudicate that.
